purpose: Phase 1 project-owned workshop web/runtime base-color derivatives

tool.name: Pillow
tool.operation: RGB resize with Image.Resampling.LANCZOS, then JPEG encode

source_policy: Original 1254x1254 RGB PNG files remain unchanged under assets/source/phase1/materials/. Runtime JPEGs are lossy derivatives only.
quality_measurement: PSNR is measured against a 512x512 LANCZOS resize of the original source.
limitations: Base-color derivatives only; no normal, roughness, AO or height maps are inferred.
JPEG is lossy and requires visual QA before art acceptance.
512px targets current RTS-distance evaluation rather than close-up final production art.
